name: Mint
copy: The original dark palette, with mint accents across the globe, project illustrations, and navigation.

name: Cobalt
copy: A navy background and pale blue accents. A quieter alternative with clear text contrast, though less distinctive than Mint or New York.

name: Paper
copy: Warm paper, charcoal text, and rust accents. Comfortable for reading the longer case studies; the technical illustrations keep their original colors.

name: New York
copy: A full-width Manhattan photograph at dusk, warm city-light accents, and an open layout that gives the skyline room. The city is the background of the page, with selected projects linked below the introduction.
